fee_notes: Royalty Fee is 7.5% of Network Revenues with a minimum of $425/month for territories with fewer than 80,000 children (ages 14 and under) or $450/month for territories with 80,000 or more children. Minimum royalty does not take effect until 60 days from Business Launch Date. National Brand Fund Contribution is 2% of Network Revenues or $275/month minimum (may increase up to 3% or $550/month minimum). Local Advertising requires a minimum of 2% of Network Revenues spent monthly. Technology Fee is currently a $3 processing fee per paid customer registration (not a fixed monthly fee; may be converted to up to 2% of Network Revenues/month or up to $9 per registration). Customer Service Center Fee is currently the greater of $0.95/minute or $332.50/month minimum, plus a Telecommunication Platform Fee of $15 or $30/month. Monthly Franchise Fee of $500/month applies only to 5-Year Agreement holders (not 10-Year). Email Fee is $14.72/month per address (first two included in Technology Fee). Systems and Support Fee currently not charged. Annual Conference Registration currently $600/attendee.

Royalty Fee Territory of fewer than 80,000 children (ages 14 and under): 7.5% of Network Revenues3 or a minimum of $425 per month, whichever is greater. Territory of 80,000 or more children (ages 14 and under): 7.5% of Network Revenues3 or a minimum of $450 per month, whichever is greater.
National Brand Fund Contribution Currently, 2% of Network Revenues or a minimum of $275 per month, whichever is greater.
Local Advertising A minimum of 2% of Network Revenues.

In addition to the fees listed above, you will pay a telecommunication platform fee which is currently $15 or $30 per month.
Franchise Fee for 5-Year Agreement $500 per month.
Email Fee Currently, $14.72 per month per address.
